name: study-design-skills
description: Biomedical study design pipeline: triage an idea → confirm design → compile spec → validate → render Table 1 / flowchart / XLSX / HTML → audit EQUATOR reporting compliance → benchmark against Cochrane evidence. Supports RCT, ITS/DiD, observational/RWE, diagnostic accuracy, prediction, evidence synthesis, qualitative, economic, and AI healthcare studies.

plugins.name: study-design-skills
plugins.description: Route a biomedical proposal through design triage, specification compilation, validation, synchronized rendering, reporting-compliance audit (32 EQUATOR guidelines + Cochrane RoB tools), and Cochrane evidence lazy-load for intervention effect benchmarking.
